entrance_antiphon.latin: Dominus secus mare Galilaeae vidit duos fratres, Petrum et Andream, et vocavit eos: Venite post me, faciam vos fieri piscatores hominum
entrance_antiphon.english: Beside the Sea of Galilee, the Lord saw two brothers, Peter and Andrew, and he said to them: Come after me and I will make you fishers of men.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dixit Andreas Simoni fratri suo: Invenimus Messiam, qui dicitur Christus. Et adduxit eum ad Iesum.
communion_antiphon.english: Andrew told his brother Simon: We have found the Messiah, the Christ, and he brought him to Jesus.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Confitebor tibi in populis, Domine, et narrabo nomen tuum fratribus mei.
entrance_antiphon.english: I will praise you, Lord, among the nations; I will tell of your name to my kin.

communion_antiphon.latin: Quod dico vobis in tenebris, dicite in lumine, dicit Dominus, et quod in aure auditis, praedicate super tecta.
communion_antiphon.english: What I say to you in the darkness speak in the light, says the Lord; what you hear whispered proclaim on the housetops.

title: St. John Damascene

entrance_antiphon.latin: In medio Ecclesiae aperuit os eius, et implevit eum Dominus spiritu sapientiae et intellectus: stolam gloriae induit eum.
entrance_antiphon.english: In the midst of the Church he opened his mouth, and the Lord filled him with the spirit of wisdom and understanding and clothed him in a robe of glory.

communion_antiphon.latin: Qui meditabitur in lege Domini die ac nocte, dabit fructum suum in tempore suo.
communion_antiphon.english: He who ponders the law of the Lord day and night will yield fruit in due season.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Gaudens gaudebo in Domino, et exsultabit anima mea in Deo meo; quia induit me vestimentis salutis, et indumento iustitiae circumdedit me, quasi sponsam ornatam monilibus suis
entrance_antiphon.english: I rejoice heartily in the Lord, in my God is the joy of my soul; for he has clothed me with a robe of salvation, and wrapped me in a mantle of justice, like a bride adorned with her jewels.

communion_antiphon.latin: Gloriosa dicta sunt de te, Maria, quia ex te ortus est sol iustitiae, Christus Deus noster.
communion_antiphon.english: Glorious things are spoken of you, O Mary, for from you arose the sun of justice, Christ our God.

title: Juan Diego

entrance_antiphon.english: In your strength, O Lord, the just one rejoices; how greatly your salvation makes him glad! You have granted him his soul's desire.

communion_antiphon.english: Whoever wishes to come after me, must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me, says the Lord.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Beata es, Virgo Maria, quae omnium portasti creatorem; genuisti qui te fecit, et in aeternum permanes Virgo.
entrance_antiphon.english: Blessed are you, O Virgin Mary, who bore the Creator of all things. You became the Mother of your Maker, and you remain for ever

communion_antiphon.latin: Fecit mihi magna, qui potens est, et sanctum nomen eius.
communion_antiphon.english: He who is mighty has done great things for me, and holy is his name.

entrance_antiphon.english: A great sign appeared in the sky, a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dominus deposuit potentes de sede, et exaltavit humiles.
communion_antiphon.english: The Lord has cast down the mighty from their thrones, and has lifted up the lowly. Or: God has not acted thus for any other nation; to no other people has he shown his love so clearly.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Mihi autem absit gloriari, nisi in cruce Domini nostri Iesu Christi, per quem mihi mundus crucifixus est, et ego mundo.
entrance_antiphon.english: May I never boast, except in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

communion_antiphon.latin: Qui vult venire post me, abneget semetipsum, et tollat crucem suam, et sequatur me, dicit Dominus.
communion_antiphon.english: Whoever wishes to come after me must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me, says the Lord.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Deus meus es tu, et confitebor tibi: Deus meus es tu, et exaltabo te; confitebor tibi, quoniam factus es mihi in salutem.
entrance_antiphon.english: You are my God, and I confess you; you are my God, and I exalt you; I will thank you, for you became my savior.

communion_antiphon.latin: Mitte manum tuam, et cognosce loca clavorum: et noli esse incredulus, sed fidelis.
communion_antiphon.english: Bring your hand and feel the place of the nails, and do not be unbelieving but believing.

entrance_antiphon.english: The shepherds went in haste, and found Mary and Joseph and the Infant lying in a manger.

communion_antiphon.latin: Deus noster in terris visus est, et cum hominibus conversatus est.
communion_antiphon.english: Our God has appeared on the earth, and lived among us.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Apertae sunt ianuae caeli beato Stephano, qui in numero Martyrum inventus est primus, et ideo triumphat in caelis coronatus.
entrance_antiphon.english: The gates of heaven were opened for blessed Stephen, who was found to be first among the number of the Martyrs and therefore is crowned triumphant in heaven.

communion_antiphon.latin: Lapidabant Stephanum, invocantem et dicentem; Domine Jesu, suscipe spiritum meum.
communion_antiphon.english: As they were stoning Stephen, he called out, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Iste est Ioannes qui supra pectus Domini in cena recubuit: beatus Apostolus, cui revelata sunt secreta celestia, et verba vitae in toto terrarum orbe diffudit.
entrance_antiphon.english: This is John, who reclined on the Lord's breast at supper, the blessed Apostle, to whom celestial secrets were revealed and who spread the words of life through all the world. Or: In medio ecclesiae aperuit os eius, et implevit eum Dominus spiritu sapientiae et intellectus, stolam gloriae induit eum. In the midst of the Church he opened his mouth, and the Lord filled him with the spirit of wisdom and understanding and clothed him in a robe of glory.

communion_antiphon.latin: Verbum caro factum est et habit�vit in nobis. Et de plenitúdine eius nos omnes accépimus.
communion_antiphon.english: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us, and from his fullness we have all received.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Innocentes pro Christo infantes occisi sunt, ipsum sequuntur Agnum sine macula, et dicunt semper: Gloria tibi, Domini.
entrance_antiphon.english: The innocents were slaughtered as infants for Christ; spotless, they follow the Lamb and sing for ever: Glory to you, O Lord.

communion_antiphon.latin: Hi empti sunt ex hominibus, primitae Deo et Agno; hi sequuntur Agnum quocumque ierit.
communion_antiphon.english: Behold those redeemed as the first fruits of the human race for God and the Lamb, and who follow the Lamb wherever he goes.

entrance_antiphon.english: At the name of Jesus, every knee should bend, of those in heaven and on earth and under the earth, and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

communion_antiphon.english: We proclaim Christ crucified; Christ, the power of God and the wisdom of God.

entrance_antiphon.english: At the name of Jesus, every knee should bend, of those in heaven and on earth and under the earth, and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

entrance_antiphon.english: Behold a wise woman who has built her house. She feared the Lord and walked the right path. Or: This is the generation which seeks the face of the God of Jacob.

communion_antiphon.english: I am the living bread from heaven, says the Lord. Whoever eats this bread will live forever; the bread I shall give is my flesh for the life of the world.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Dóminus pars heriditátus me et cálicis mei; tu es qui detínes sortem meam. Funes cecidérunt mihi in præcláris; ins&uper et heréditas mea speciósa est mihi.
entrance_antiphon.english: O Lord, my allotted portion and my cup, you it is who hold fast my lot. For me the measuring lines have fallen on pleasant site; fair to me indeed is my inheritance.

communion_antiphon.latin: Omnis qui relíquit domos vel fratres aut sorores aut patrem aut matrem aut fílios aut agros propter nomen meum, centúplum accípiet et vitam ætérnam possidébit.
communion_antiphon.english: Everyone who has given up home, brothers, or sisters, father or mother, wife or children or property for my sake will receive many times as much and inherit everlasting life.

communion_antiphon.english: I live by faith in the Son of God, who has loved me and given himself up for me.

entrance_antiphon.english: Your merciful love, O God, we have received in the midst of your temple. Your praise, O God, like your name, reaches the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with saving justice.

communion_antiphon.latin: Viderunt oculi mei salutare tuum, quod parasti ante faciem omnium populorum.

entrance_antiphon.english: The wicked have told me lies, but not so is your law: I spoke of your decrees before kings, and was not confounded (E.T. alleluia).

communion_antiphon.latin: Non iudicavi me scire aliquid inter vos, nisi Iesum Christum, et hunc crucifixum.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Benedicta es tu, Virgo Maria, a Domino Deo excelso prae omnibus mulieribus super terram; quia nomen tuum it magnificavit, ut non recedat laus tua de ore hominum.
entrance_antiphon.english: Blessed are you, O Virgin Mary, by the Lord God Most High, above all women on the earth; for he has so exalted your name, that your praise shall be undying on our lips.

communion_antiphon.latin: Beatam me dicent omnes generationes, quia ancillam humilem respexit Deus.

entrance_antiphon.english: We should glory in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, in whom is our salvation, life and resurrection, through whom we are saved and delivered.

communion_antiphon.latin: Ego si exaltatus fuero a terra, omnes traham ad meipsum, dicit Dominus.
communion_antiphon.english: When I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw everyone to myself, says the Lord.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Dixit Simeon ad Mariam: Ecce, positus est hic in ruinam et in resurrectionem multorum in Israel, et in signum cui contradicetur; et tuam ipsius animam pertransibit gladius.

communion_antiphon.latin: Communicantes Christi passionibus gaudete, ut et in revelatione gloriae eius gaudeteatis exsultantes.

title: St. Jerome

entrance_antiphon.latin: Beatus vir, qui meditabitur in lege Domini die ac nocte: dabit fructum suum in tempore suo.
entrance_antiphon.english: Blessed indeed is he who ponders the law of the Lord day and night: he will yield his fruit in due season.

communion_antiphon.latin: Domine Deus, inventi sunt sermones tuos, et comedi eos; et factum est mihi verbum tuum in gaudium et in laetitiam cordis mei.
communion_antiphon.english: Lord God, your words were found and I consumed them; your word became the joy and the happiness of my heart.

common_of: Common of Doctors of the Church
Common of Pastors

entrance_antiphon.latin: Circumduxit eam Dominus et docuit; et custodivit quasi pupillam oculi sui. Sicut aquila expandit alas suas, et assumpsit eam, atque portavit in humeris suis. Dominus solus dux eius fuit.
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord led her and taught her, and kept her as the apple of his eye. Like an eagle spreading its wings he took her up and bore her on his shoulders. The Lord alone was her guide.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dicit Dominus: Nisi conversi fueritis, et efficiamini sicut parvuli, non intrabitis in regnum caelorum.
communion_antiphon.english: Thus says the Lord: Unless you turn and become like children, you will not enter the Kingdom of Heaven.

title: Protection of the Mother of God

entrance_antiphon.latin: Benedicite, omnes Angeli Domini, Dominum, hymnum dicite, et superexaltate eum in saecula.
entrance_antiphon.english: Angels of the Lord, bless the Lord, praise and exalt him above all for ever.

communion_antiphon.latin: In conspectu Angelorum psallam tibi, Deus meus.
communion_antiphon.english: In the presence of the Angels I will praise you, my God

entrance_antiphon.latin: Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum: benedicta tu in mulieribus, et benedictus fructus ventris tui.
entrance_antiphon.english: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women and blessed is the fruit of your womb

communion_antiphon.latin: Ecce concipies in utero, et paries filium, et vocabis nomen eius Iesum.
communion_antiphon.english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and bear a son, and you shall name him Jesus.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Quemadmodum desiderat cervus ad fontes aquarum, ita desiderat anima mea ad te, Deus. Sitivit anima mea ad Deum fortem, vivum.
entrance_antiphon.english: Like the deer that yearns for running streams, so my soul is yearning for you, my God; my soul is thirsting for God, the living God.

communion_antiphon.latin: Misericordias Domini in aeternum cantabo in generationem et generationem annuntiabo veritatem tuam in ore meo.
communion_antiphon.english: I will sing for ever of your mercies, O Lord through all ages my mouth will proclaim your fidelity.

title: Margaret Mary Alacoque
common_of: Common of Virgins: For One Virgin

entrance_antiphon.latin: Christo confixus sum cruci; vivo autem, iam non ego; vivit vero in me Christus; in fide vivo Filii Dei, qui dilexit me, et tradidit se ipsum pro me.
entrance_antiphon.english: I am crucified with Christ, yet I live; no longer I, but Christ lives in me. I live by faith in the Son of God, who has loved me and given himself up for me.

communion_antiphon.latin: Frumentum Christi sum; dentibus bestiarum molar, ut panis mundus inveniar.
communion_antiphon.english: I am the wheat of Christ to be ground by the teeth of beasts, that I may be found to be pure bread.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Quam pulchri super montes pedes adnuntiantis et praedicantis pacem, adnuntiantis bonum, praedicantis salutem!
entrance_antiphon.english: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings glad tidings of peace, bearing good news, announcing salvation! says the Lord.

communion_antiphon.latin: Misit Dominus discipulos, qui nuntiarent civitatibus: Appropinquavit in vos regnum Dei.
communion_antiphon.english: The Lord sent out disciples to proclaim throughout the towns: The kingdom of God is at hand for you.

title: Isaac Jogues and John De Brebeuf

entrance_antiphon.latin: Non iudicavi me scire aliquid inter vos, nisi Iesum Christum, et hunc crucifixum
entrance_antiphon.english: I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except for Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

communion_antiphon.latin: Nos praedicamus Christum crucifixum, Christum, Dei virtutem et Dei sapientiam.
communion_antiphon.english: We proclaim Christ crucified; Christ, the power of God and the wisdom of God.

common_of: Common of Pastors: For Missionaries
For a Bishop

entrance_antiphon.latin: Isti sunt viri sancti, quos elegit Dominus in caritate non ficta, et dedit illis gloriam sempiternam.
entrance_antiphon.english: These are the holy men whom the Lord chose in his own perfect love; to them he gave eternal glory.

communion_antiphon.latin: Si quis diligit me, sermonem meum servabit, dicit Dominus, et Pater meus diliget eum, et ad eum veniemus, et mansiones apud eum faciemus.
communion_antiphon.english: Whoever loves me will keep my word, says the Lord; and my Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Gaudeamus omnes in Domino, diem festum celebrantes sub honore Sanctorum omnium, de quorum sollemnitate gaudent Angeli, et collaudant Filium Dei.
entrance_antiphon.english: Let us all rejoice in the Lord, as we celebrate the feast day in honor of all the Saints, at whose festival the Angels rejoice and praise the Son of God.

communion_antiphon.latin: Beati mundo corde: quoniam ipsi Deum videbunt. Beati pacifici: quoniam filii Dei vocabuntur. Beati qui persecutionem patiuntur propter iustitiam: quoniam ipsorum est regnum caelorum.
communion_antiphon.english: Blessed are the clean of heart, for they shall see God. Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God. Blessed are they who are persecuted for the sake of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Sicut Iesus mortuus est et resurrexit, ita et Deus eos qui dormierunt per Iesum adducet cum eo. Et sicut in Adam omnes moriuntur, ita et in Christo omnes vivificabuntur.
entrance_antiphon.english: Just as Jesus died and has risen again, so through Jesus God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep; and as in Adam all die, so also in Christ will all be brought to life

communion_antiphon.latin: Ego sum resurrectio et vita, dicit Dominus. Qui credit in me, etiam si mortuus fuerit, vivet; et omnis, qui vivit et credit in me, non morietur in aeternum.
communion_antiphon.english: I am the Resurrection and the Life, says the Lord. Whoever believes in me, even though he dies, will live, and everyone who lives and believes in me will not die for ever.

title: Martin de Porres
common_of: Common of Holy Men and Women: For Religious

title: Charles Borromeo
common_of: For a Bishop

entrance_antiphon.latin: Statuit ei Dominus testamentum pacis, et principem fecit eum, ut sit illi sacerdotii dignitas in aeternum.
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord established for him a covenant of peace, and made him the prince, that he might have the dignity of the priesthood for ever.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dixit Petrus ad Iesum: Tu es Christus, Filius Dei vivi. Respondit Iesus: Tu es Petrus, et super hanc petram aedificabo Ecclesiam meam.
communion_antiphon.english: Peter said to Jesus: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God. And Jesus replied: You are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my Church.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Suscitabo mihi sacerdotem fidelem, qui iuxta cor meum et animam meam faciet, dicit Dominus
entrance_antiphon.english: I shall raise up for myself a faithful priest who will act in accord with my heart and my mind, says the Lord.

communion_antiphon.latin: Amen dico vobis, quamdiu fecistis uni ex his fratribus meis minimis, mihi fecistis, dicit Dominus.
communion_antiphon.english: Amen, I say to you: Whatever you did for one of the least of my brethren, you did it for me, says the Lord.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Propter testamentum Domini et leges paternas sancti dei perstiterunt in amore fraternitatis: Quia unus fuit semper spiritus in eis et una fides.
entrance_antiphon.english: Because of the Lord's covenant and the ancestral laws, the Saints of God persevered in loving brotherhood, for there was always one spirit in them, and one faith.

communion_antiphon.latin: Qui perdiderit animam suam propter me, dicit Dominus, inveniet eam in aeternum.
communion_antiphon.english: Whoever loses his life for my sake, will find it in eternity, say the Lord.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Qui docti fuerint, fulgebunt quasi splendor firmamenti, et qui ad iustitiam erudiunt multos, quasi stellae in perpetuas aeternitates.
entrance_antiphon.english: Those who are wise will shine brightly like the splendor of the firmament and those who lead the many to justice shall be like the stars for ever.

communion_antiphon.latin: Nos praedicamus Christum crucifixum, Christum, Dei virtutem et Dei sapientiam.
communion_antiphon.english: We proclaim Christ crucified; Christ, the power of God and the wisdom of God.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Nos autem gloriari oportet in cruce Domini nostri Jesu Christi: in quo est salus, vita et resurrectio nostra per quem salvati et liberati sumus.
entrance_antiphon.english: May we never boast, except in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. For the word of the Cross is the power of God to us who have been saved.
